- Complete the existing browser FPS paintball game as a playable 1v1 match with upgrades, arena rotation, configurable match length, and optional online play.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

- `index.html`: Game screens and control elements.
- `style.css`: Game styling and responsive layouts.
- `start.sh`: Game launch entry point.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Objective
- Complete the browser FPS paintball game as a playable 1v1 match with upgrades, arena rotation, configurable match length, and optional online play.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, use a viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained browser game with an arena bot and optional PeerJS matches via `https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js`.
- Match setup offers 3/5/7 rounds to win and 1/3/5 arenas in rotation.
- Dash is an explicit action that moves in the selected movement direction or forward.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built game screens, arena rendering/maps, upgrades, bot behavior, PeerJS logic, round tracking, and keyboard, mouse, and touch handlers.
- Fixed round HUD health to reflect upgrade-adjusted health, initialized online `lastSync`, made both peers rotate arenas after every round, and renamed `SLIDE` to `DASH`.
- `node --check game.js` passed after those changes.
- Browser reached gameplay at 1280×800; latest reload showed the `SHIFT / DASH` label and no console errors.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/gameplay-check.jpg`.

### Active
- Verify movement, combat, round transitions, upgrade selection, arena rotation, and match completion; fix issues found.
- Verify PeerJS online synchronization if feasible.

### Blocked
- Browser keypress movement check was inconclusive: comparing minimap canvas `toDataURL()` before/after pressing W reported `moved:false`.
- A 15-second idle wait remained on round 1 at 0–0; bot match completion and transition behavior are not verified.
- User reported `./start.sh` produced no output and timed out after 120 seconds; inspect the server/process state and startup behavior.

## Next Move
1. Inspect why `./start.sh` timed out and confirm the preview server is available.
2. Resume browser checks at ≤1280px; verify player position changes directly while testing movement and shooting.
3. Exercise round outcomes, drafts, arena rotation, and match completion; address defects found.
4. Test PeerJS online flow if feasible and verify synchronization.
5. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot after any changes.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay, rendering, controls, bot, upgrades, rounds, and online logic.
- `index.html`: Game screens and controls.
- `style.css`: Game styling and responsive layouts.
- `start.sh`: Preview launch entry point.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `screenshots/gameplay-check.jpg`: Existing gameplay verification screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Existing code includes five arena themes, a 31-entry upgrade pool, ray-cast rendering, a CPU opponent, and PeerJS support.
- Browser currently showed the menu after reload; starting a match worked and rendered gameplay at 1280×800.

- Complete the browser FPS paintball game as a playable 1v1 match with upgrades, arena rotation, configurable match length, and optional online play.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, use a viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained browser game with an arena bot and optional PeerJS matches via `https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js`.
- Match setup offers 3/5/7 rounds to win and 1/3/5 arenas in rotation.
- Dash is an explicit action that moves in the selected movement direction or forward.

- Built game screens, arena rendering/maps, upgrades, bot behavior, PeerJS logic, round tracking, and keyboard, mouse, and touch handlers.

## Objective
- Complete INKBOUND as a playable browser paintball game with upgrades, arena rotation, configurable match length, and optional online play.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, use a viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained browser game with an arena bot and optional PeerJS matches via `https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js`.
- Match setup offers 3/5/7 rounds to win and 1/3/5 arenas in rotation.
- Dash is an explicit action that moves in the selected movement direction or forward.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game screens, five arena themes, upgrades, bot, PeerJS flow, rounds, and keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- Fixed movement, room-code handling, and online joiner spawn so players start at opposite ends; verified joiner movement synchronizes to host.
- Verified direct player damage, bot-caused round loss, round/draft/arena progression, match completion, and pointer lock.
- Verified two browser pages connect and start an online match without page errors.
- Saved `screenshots/inkbound-latest.jpg` at 1100×720.

### Active
- Fix online score synchronization: after host wins a round, host shows `ps:1, es:0`, while joiner shows `ps:0, es:1`; mismatch persists after next round starts.
- Remove temporary `window.__testGame` hook from `game.js` and run final checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Correct host/join score mapping in online `state`, `round`, and `finish` messages; rerun two-page round progression and verify score UI.
2. Remove temporary `window.__testGame` hook from `game.js`.
3. Run final syntax/gameplay checks and inspect the latest screenshot if gameplay changes affect it.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay, rounds, online synchronization, joiner spawn logic, and temporary `window.__testGame` hook.
- `index.html`: Game screens and online room-code input.
- `style.css`: Game styling and responsive layouts.
- `screenshots/inkbound-latest.jpg`: Latest saved gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Preview responds at `http://localhost:3000/`.
- Online host sends `p.score=state.playerScore` and `e.score=state.enemyScore`; joiner currently assigns `playerScore=msg.e.score` and `enemyScore=msg.p.score`. `round` and `finish` handlers also reverse `ps` and `es`.
- The current `window.__testGame` exposes only `snapshot`; it is temporary and should be removed after final testing.
